title: HEAP: county applications and published household shares
description: The actual OHFA public CSV with its literal measure labels.
methodology: Published counts are labeled applications. The narrative uses household participation; the retained guide makes the distinction explicit. Published shares retain their displayed precision; no denominator is reconstructed.

source.title: OHFA Housing Needs Assessment: HHHEAP county CSV
source.publisher: Ohio Housing Finance Agency / Ohio Department of Development
source.note: Source context cites ACS five-year DP04; exact denominator release span is not specified.
source.rights: Attributed statistical facts; original publisher rights remain with its source.

values.denominator: ACS five-year households, DP04; exact release span unstated

rows.note: The CSV names applications; the accompanying narrative calls the measure participating households. Preserve this definitional distinction. No approved, paid or unique-household count is inferred.
